gamefaqs.section: Action Replay Max DS (.duc) Game Save (North America)

format: Action Replay DS save: the 500-byte 'ARDS000000000001' header (game 'Bomberman', name 'Level 10-6'), then 512 bytes raw for the 512 B EEPROM (exact size)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/nds-ards.py IN step0.bin, then tools/gamefaqs/nds-cores.py step0.bin --chip 512 --stem 'Bomberman (USA)' --out DIR: drops the Action Replay header; fits it to the 512-byte chip (exact size) and writes each core's file

desmume.detail: File Select: File A "Sam747" AREA 10-06 CLEAR 095% TIME 003:57, File B "Sam747" AREA 02-01, File C "Lee" AREA 01-01; "You have a quick save!"
